title: H-MSAE: Hierarchical Sparse Concept Coverage for Efficient and Diverse Instruction Data Selection
abstract: arXiv:2611.27329v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large instruction-tuning corpora contain substantial semantic redundancy, motivating the selection of compact subsets that preserve useful supervision while reducing training cost. Existing diversity-aware selectors often rely on generated semantic tags and explicit graph structures, introducing considerable annotation and preprocessing overhead. We introduce H-MSAE, a hierarchical sparse instruction selection framework that organizes multi-resolution concepts learned by a Matryoshka sparse autoencoder into a coarse-to-fine hierarchy. Quality-weighted, diminishing-return coverage with ancestor propagation promotes high-quality and non-redundant semantic coverage, while pool-relative length constraints regulate subset composition. We motivate this design through a local quality-diversity analysis of subset SFT utility and examine it using example-quality and representation-space diversity diagnostics. translated_title: H-MSAE：基于层次化稀疏概念覆盖的高效多样指令数据选择
translated_abstract: 大型指令微调语料库包含大量的语义冗余，这促使研究者选择紧凑的数据子集，在降低训练成本的同时保留有效的监督信号。现有的多样性感知选择器通常依赖于生成的语义标签和显式的图结构，带来了相当可观的标注和预处理开销。我们提出了H-MSAE，这是一个层次化稀疏指令选择框架，它将由Matryoshka稀疏自编码器学习到的多分辨率概念组织成从粗到细的层次结构。质量加权、边际收益递减的覆盖机制结合祖先传播，促进高质量且非冗余的语义覆盖，而相对于数据池的长度约束则规范子集的构成。我们通过对子集SFT效用的局部质量-多样性分析来论证该设计的合理性，并利用示例质量和表示空间多样性诊断对其进行检验。在Tulu 3数据池上，H-MSAE实现了……
tldr: 提出H-MSAE框架，利用Matryoshka稀疏自编码器将多分辨率概念组织成从粗到细的层次结构，并通过质量加权的边际收益递减覆盖机制，高效地选择高质量、多样化的指令数据子集，避免了传统方法对语义标签标注和图结构的依赖。
en_tdlr: H-MSAE organizes multi-resolution concepts from a Matryoshka sparse autoencoder into a coarse-to-fine hierarchy and employs quality-weighted diminishing-return coverage to efficiently select high-quality and diverse instruction data subsets, avoiding the annotation and graph-structure overhead of existing diversity-aware selectors.
